mapper.select: /** give-operation-mapper.getCtbnyOpratnDetail (기부금 운용정보 사용정보 상세) */ SELECT A.regist_sn ,A.locgov_code ,A.bsns_purps_code ,A.expndtr_amt ,A.bsns_nm ,A.bsns_cn ,A.login_id AS login_id ,A.user_name AS user_name ,A.frst_register_id ,A.expndtr_de ,A.rm FROM ( SELECT regist_sn ,GCO.locgov_code ,bsns_purps_code ,NVL(expndtr_amt,0) AS expndtr_amt ,bsns_nm ,bsns_cn ,OU.login_id ,OU.user_name ,GCO.frst_register_id ,GCO.expndtr_de ,GCO.rm FROM G_CTBNY_OPRATN GCO INNER JOIN OP_USER OU ON GCO.frst_register_id = OU.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND GCO.regist_sn = #{registSn} ) A

/** give-operation-mapper.getCtbnyOpratnFile (기부금 운용정보 파일 목록) */ SELECT REGIST_FILE_ID ,REGIST_SN ,FILE_NM ,FILE_TY ,SORT_ORDR ,ORGINL_FILE_NM ,FRST_REGISTER_ID ,FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM G_CTBNY_OPRATN_FILE WHERE REGIST_SN = #{registSn}

/** give-operation-mapper.getCtbnyOpratnFile (기부금 운용정보 파일 상세) */ SELECT REGIST_FILE_ID ,REGIST_SN ,FILE_NM ,FILE_TY ,SORT_ORDR ,ORGINL_FILE_NM ,FRST_REGISTER_ID ,FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM G_CTBNY_OPRATN_FILE WHERE REGIST_FILE_ID = #{registFileId}
